title: Charge the actual finite-cover resource and rare confidence failures
statement: For canonical small-survival cover size C_epsilon and depth H_epsilon, fresh batches with delta_j=delta/[j(j+1)] give preparations O(C_epsilon epsilon^-2 log(C_epsilon/delta)) and applications/reports O(H_epsilon C_epsilon epsilon^-2 log(C_epsilon/delta)). A bound on confidence-failure counts gives almost-sure termination and the same unconditional expected orders when the comparison cover is finite.

requires: Common reversible preparation/readout v>0,||v||=1; selfadjoint positivity-preserving contractions with A_i v<=v
Fresh independent preparations and paid chosen-action alive/absorbed observations; live reports are not resets
Output is unconditional absolute scalar survival for every fixed switching word, including words selected after acquisition
A finite comparison cover; no supplied value for its size is required
provides: A task-specific sufficient acquisition-cost theorem including failure histories
assumptions: Not a lower bound against methods exploiting additional structure
The resource is cover size/depth, not a claim that every coarse process has a small cover
costs: Every primitive application,live/absorbed report,fresh preparation,arithmetic and stored prefix is paid
Actual source is countably infinite with operator norm1/infinite mean lifetime; a finite approximation does not identify its hidden state
contract.obstruction: A high-confidence cost claim alone can leave expected cost undefined on failure histories.

evidence.quote: # Adaptive prefix-cover acquisition: scoped cost theorem and review
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: The adaptive route is the executed winner for this scalar prediction task; it returns a prefix predictor rather than the fixed-tape route’s two-state model. Cost depends on an actual finite small-survival cover, not hidden dimension alone. Rare confidence failures are included in unconditional expected cost/termination proofs. Live labels never reset memory; no full transcript, normalized-survivor or physical apparatus claim is inherited. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Delivered completed scoped cost theorem and operational/statistical comparator review; exact replay of saved acquisition decisions is producer evidence, not replay by Capital.
